items.title: Exactness of the induced sequences on kernels and cokernels in a commutative diagram
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file homology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that in a commutative diagram whose first row is exact and whose map between the last terms is a monomorphism the induced sequence on kernels is exact, and dually that the induced sequence on cokernels is exact when the second row is exact and the middle vertical map is an epimorphism (statement lines 1185-1206). The proof is a complete argument for the first assertion: after exhibiting the induced maps and the canonical injections the author verifies the vanishing of the composite, then uses the fibre-product criterion twice to produce the auxiliary object and the morphism into the first kernel that witness exactness (proof lines 1208-1224); the second assertion follows by duality (proof line 1225). The non-formal content is the two applications of the exactness criterion. The claim is H2: a structured argument with each input named.
